item.description: ### Fixed - **Perch says when your Cursor sign-in has expired.** It used to just drop the Cursor usage row, which looked exactly like having no Cursor account — so the bars quietly stopped updating with nothing to explain why, and no way back except guessing. The row now tells you to sign in again. A slow or throttled Cursor still says nothing, because that fixes itself. - **A question from Claude no longer shows Allow/Deny.** When Claude asks you something, neither button could answer it — Allow only approved the asking, and Deny stopped Claude asking at all. It now shows as a question.
